newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asian stocks end 1996 mixed or lower.
newsitem.headline: Asian stocks end 1996 mixed or lower.

text.p: Asian stock markets ended the year mixed or lower Tuesday in thin trading marked by profit-taking and window-dressing, dealers said.
Half-day sessions were held in Hong Kong and Singapore while many markets, including Tokyo, were closed for the holidays.
Hong Kong shares fell on profit-taking and a dip on Wall Street Monday. They clawed part of the way back from sharp losses in early trading.
The Hang Seng Index finished 29.30 points lower at 13,451.45, after recovering from a 116-point drop at the open.
Singapore shares ended mixed on scattered year-end buying, dealers said.
"There was some window-dressing which pushed up certain stocks. But the volumes were so thin, there was hardly any activity," said a dealer with a local bank.
The Straits Times Industrials Index ended 1.66 points down at 2,216.79 while the SES All-share index was up 3.48 points at 536.12.
The Singapore market will be closed on Wednesday for the New Year and on Thursday for Singapore's elections.
